title: NoDeath
description: This plugin is make you invincible if you turned on, very useful if you make a video and you don't want to die.
body:
If you turned it on, you can't die, if your turn off, you can die. If you want to turned it on, you need to type "/nodeath <IGN> on>, but if you want to turn off, you need to type "/nodeath <IGN> off". 

It's helpful if you don't want to die lol
